Experts in Agronomy
MFA takes crop production to the next level by combining the latest technologies, industry-leading services and unparalleled expertise in seed, crop protection, plant foods, precision agriculture and grain marketing. Our focus on customer partnering means growers can trust that the agronomic solutions we deliver are tailor-made for each operation.
View More
Crop Protection
MFA is a full-service crop protection supplier, providing a complete line of products and services needed in today’s agronomic environment.
View More >
Seed
With a vast portfolio of proprietary and partner brands, MFA offers the latest traits and technology to ensure you get the most return out of your seed investment.
View More >
Fertilizer
MFA is a leading supplier of plant food with an extensive network of facilities and equipment for unparalleled capacity and timely delivery to dealers and farmers.
View More >
Agronomy
Standouts across the state
After the challenges of the 2026 growing season, thinking about 2027 may be the last thing on a grower’s mind. While this year’s crop is still the top priority, it’s never too early to start evaluating options for next season. That’s where our variety trial data comes in. Evaluating products in diverse environments allows us to see how hybrids and varieties perform under varying conditions and helps identify products that may be a good fit for operations similar to your own.
Learn More >
Experts in Livestock
MFA offers innovations for animal agriculture that no other company can. We know that when it comes to raising livestock, success doesn’t just happen. That’s why our full line of quality feed, animal health and farm supply products are backed by the expertise and services you need to maximize herd performance and your bottom line.
View More
Animal Health
MFA knows that livestock producers are vital to the food chain. We support that role with medications, vaccines and supplies to help keep animals healthy, safe and profitable.
View More >
Feed
With a longstanding reputation for quality and expertise, MFA manufactures and supplies a wide selection of feeds and supplements for livestock and companion animals.
View More >
Farm Supply
Whether you’re running a large cattle operation or caring for a few acres of land, MFA carries all the supplies, equipment and tools needed for farming and rural living.
View More >
Livestock
More than ever, cow nutrition drives calf value
In a market where every calf carries significant value, the right feeding program for your cows is one of the most important investments you can make. Research shows that the nutrients a cow receives during pregnancy can influence fetal development, calf vigor, immune function and future performance. That means a calf’s profitability begins long before birth. And that’s why maternal nutrition matters more than ever.
Learn More >
Purpose: It's what makes MFA — MFA
When everything around us changes — markets, weather, technology, leadership — what’s the one thing that remains the same? Purpose. More than 112 years ago, MFA was created by farmers, for farmers. Through good times and difficult seasons, this cooperative has endured because our purpose has never wavered.
